top_violation_types.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The permit holder has not completed the annual certification.

top_violation_types.title: Required Health Statement (26 TAC §747.611(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two of the four children records reviewed were missing health statements.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §747.1503(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During an investigation, it was determined an infant was placed in a play yard in another room unsupervised and sustained minor injuries.

top_violation_types.title: HRC42.052(c) - AP Illegal Operation - Not Listed (26 TAC §HRC42.052(c) - AP Illegal Operation - No)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Regular care is being provided to 2 unrelated children.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation made changes to the outside playground area and did not notify Child Care Regulations, that the changes were completed. Children were observed playing on the new play equipment.   The operation did not notify Child Care Regulations that they were moving classrooms and using one room that was unlicensed space.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness (26 TAC §746.305(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operation failed to notify Licensing of a reportable illness within the required timeframe.
